title: Special Assets Standard: Nonaccrual Status of Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
**Placement.** A Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage in active status is placed in nonaccrual when an installment remains not paid in full more than the product's nonaccrual days in calendar days after its due date, the due date being day 0.

**While in nonaccrual.** Payments are still applied, late charges stop, default interest continues to be booked, and no conversion or partial release is available.

**Return to accrual.** The loan returns to active status on the day every past-due installment is paid in full.

## Status effects

| Activity | Active status | Nonaccrual status |
|---|---|---|
| Payments applied | yes | yes |
| Late charges | charged under the late-charge rules | stop |
| Default interest | under the installment billing rules | continues to be booked |
| Conversion | available under the conversion rules | not available |
| Partial release | available under the release rules | not available |

## Boundary (hypothetical dates)

With a 90-day threshold and an installment due on 1 February 2026 (day 0) that remains not paid in full: on 2 May 2026 (day 90) the threshold has not been passed; on 3 May 2026 (day 91) it has, and the loan is placed in nonaccrual. If every past-due installment is paid in full on 20 June 2026, the loan returns to active status that day.
